title: FRAUD?!
body: Offered trial for 7 days but charged me of the annual fee TWICE on the same day.
author: dockayo

title: Double charged despite still being on free trial. No app support.
body: As the title says— I signed on for a 3 day free trial. On th same day, I got charged the annual fee TWICE. Reached out for at least a refund of the extra charge, but I received no response.
author: danieleazar
